description: Create a conversion goal. confirmed=false (default) returns a preview without writing; confirmed=true creates it.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

items.description: A listed context field, properties.<key>, or trait:<key>. Trait filters take equals, not_equals, in or not_in only, compare current values as strings, and need read access to the website.

field.description: Visitor dimension or properties.<key> on the conversion event.

operator.description: How to compare the selected field with value.

value.description: Comparison text, or a list for membership matching; numeric comparisons use number text.

filters.description: Filters every conversion must match. properties.<key> filters apply to the conversion event; gt/gte/lt/lte compare numeric property values.

ignoreHistoricData.description: true counts only data from the goal's creation date onward.

target.description: Page path for PAGE_VIEW (* matches any characters, e.g. /docs/*), event name for EVENT or CUSTOM.

type.description: PAGE_VIEW: target is a page path. EVENT or CUSTOM: target is an event name.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: create_goal

outputSchema.description: message describes the outcome. preview and confirmationRequired identify a review without writing; current and updates show proposed edits when present. goal contains its name, conversion type/target, filters and historical-data policy; saved results also include ID, activation and update time; success confirms an applied mutation.

title: Create goal
